title: A detailed protocol for expression, purification, and activity determination of recombinant SaCas9
protocol: Inoculate a single colony of pET28-SaCas9 transformed One Shot BL21 Star (DE3) bacteria in 5 mL LB-medium supplemented with 50 μg/mL Kanamycin sulfate and incubate at 37°C for 12–16 h.
Transfer the pre-culture into 1 L LB-medium supplemented with 50 μg/mL Kanamycin sulfate and shake vigorously at 37°C.
Measure the optical density at 600 nm (OD600) every 30 min until it reaches a value of 0.5–0.6 (4–6 h).
Add IPTG to a final concentration of 200 μM and incubate for 12–16 h at 18°C with vigorous shaking.
Centrifuge the bacteria for 20 min at 2,500 × g and 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Thaw the frozen bacteria pellet on ice and re-suspend in 50 mL lysis buffer until no cell clumps are visible.
Incubate the lysis solution on ice for about 30 minutes.
Freeze the lysis solution using liquid nitrogen.
Thaw the frozen lysis solution at 30°C in an ultrasonic bath for 8 minutes.
Repeat the freezing and thawing process four more times.
Centrifuge the lysis solution for 20 minutes at 4°C and 2,500 × g.
Transfer the supernatant carefully to a fresh tube.
Repeat the centrifugation of the supernatant for another 20 minutes at 4°C and 2,500 × g.
Collect samples of the pellet and the supernatant (30 μL) for analysis by SDS-PAGE.
Filter the supernatant from the second centrifugation step using a syringe filter (0.45 μm).
Perform an IMAC using the ÄKTApurifier system or an equivalent system in combination with a 1 mL HisTrap FF Crude column.
Use a flow-rate of 1 mL/min for all steps of the IMAC.
Degas all buffers before use.
Wash the column with double distilled water (5 column volumes).
Equilibrate the column with five column volumes washing buffer containing 25 mM imidazole.
Load the sample onto the column using a superloop (∼40 mL).
Collect a sample of the flow-through (30 μL) for analysis by SDS-PAGE.
Wash the column with 20 CVs washing buffer and collect four fractions (5 mL).
Elute SaCas9 with 12 CVs of elution buffer containing 60% elution buffer and 40% washing buffer (final concentration of imidazole 190 mM).
Collect 1 mL fractions during elution.
Clean the column with 10 CVs of elution buffer at 100% concentration.
Wash the column with five CVs of double distilled water.
Apply five CVs of 20% v/v ethanol for storage of the column.
Pool the fractions containing recombinant SaCas9 (∼128 kDa) from the HisTrap FF Crude column.
Store the pooled recombinant SaCas9 at 4°C for 12–16 h and continue on the next day with SEC.
Degas all buffers before use.
Wash the HiLoad 16/600 Superdex 200 Prep Grade column with four CVs of double distilled water.
Equilibrate the column with two CVs of sample buffer at a flow-rate of 1 mL/min for 12–16 h.
Use a 5 mL sample loop for loading the pooled IMAC fractions (∼3 mL).
Wash the loop with 25 mL of sample buffer.
Purify recombinant SaCas9 with one CV of sample buffer at a flow-rate of 0.3 mL/min.
Collect 1 mL fractions during elution.
Analyze the fractions from SEC using SDS-PAGE (8%) in combination with Coomassie-R250 staining.
Pool the fractions containing pure recombinant SaCas9, excluding those with significant protein contaminations.
Clean the column with one CV sample buffer.
Wash the column with four CVs double distilled water.
Apply four CVs 20% v/v ethanol for storage of the column at 1 mL/min flow-rate.
Concentrate the eluted recombinant SaCas9 using Amicon Ultra 0.5 mL centrifuge filter units (30 kDa molecular cutoff).
Determine the protein concentration using the Pierce 660 nm Protein Assay in combination with the M1000 Infinite plate reader.
Add 50% v/v glycerin and mix gently.
Calculate and weigh the exact amount of glycerol instead of pipetting (density = 1.26 g/mL).
Add glycerol to prevent protein precipitation during freezing.
Run an SDS-PAGE (8%) in combination with Coomassie-R250 staining using defined amounts of recombinant SaCas9 (50-2,500 ng) to determine purity.
Verify the expression of purified recombinant SaCas9 by Western blot analysis before performing downstream applications.
Transfer proteins onto a Trans-Blot Turbo Transfer Pack membrane using the Trans-Blot Turbo System according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Incubate the membrane in 5% w/v skimmed milk powder in TBST for 1 hour at 20°C.
Incubate the membrane with monoclonal mouse anti SaCas9 antibodies (0.5 μg/mL) in TBST supplemented with 5% w/v skimmed milk powder for 12–16 hours at 4°C.
Wash the membrane five times with TBST.

Incubate the membrane with polyclonal goat anti-mouse immunoglobulin antibodies conjugated to horseradish peroxidase (HRP, 0.1 μg/mL) in TBST supplemented with 5% w/v skimmed milk powder for 1 hour at 20°C.
Wash the membrane five times with TBST.
Incubate the membrane in WesternBright Quantum HRP substrate according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Detect chemiluminescence signal using an appropriate detection system.
Perform a polymerase chain reaction (PCR) using the oligonucleotides LMNA_for and LMNA_rev in combination with human genomic DNA as a template.
Use a DNA polymerase with proofreading function for the PCR.
Purify the PCR product using the GeneJET PCR Purification Kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Measure the concentration of the purified PCR product using a NanoDrop 2000 photometer or an alternative photometer.
Store the purified PCR product at −20°C.
Perform an in vitro transcription using the template oligonucleotide and T7 primer in combination with the MEGAshortscript T7 Transcription Kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Anneal 1 μL of the template oligonucleotide (100 μM) with 1 μL of the T7 primer (100 μM).
Heat the mixture for 5 min to 95°C using a thermocycler.
Cool down to 20°C at a rate of Δ5°C per minute.
Dilute the annealed oligonucleotides to a final concentration of 0.5 μM with RNase free water.
Perform an in vitro transcription according to the specified protocol and incubate at 37°C for 4 hours.
Add 1 μL Turbo DNase (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and incubate at 37°C for 15 min.
Add 115 μL RNase free water and 15 μL ammonium acetate solution (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
Gently mix the reaction solution.
Add 300 μL ethanol to the mixture and mix thoroughly.
Incubate the mixture at -20°C for 15 min.
Centrifuge at 4°C at 10,000 × g for 15 min.
Remove the supernatant carefully without touching the pellet with the pipet tip.
Resuspend the sgRNA in 50 μL RNase free water.
Measure the concentration of the synthesized single guide RNA (sgRNA) using the NanoDrop 2000 or an alternative photometer.
Store the purified sgRNA in aliquots at -80°C.
Run an urea polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis (UREA-PAGE) at 100 V for about 2 hours using the specified sample buffer dye.
Incubate the gel with GelStar Nucleic Acid Gel Stain (1:5000) for about 20 minutes at 20°C.
Detect the bands using a gel documentation system.
Mix 2.5 pmol of purified recombinant SaCas9 and 2.5 pmol of the sgRNA on ice.
Add 10-fold reaction buffer and complement with RNase-free water (total volume 10 μL).
Incubate the samples for 10 minutes at 25°C.
Add 0.2 pmol of the purified target PCR product.
Incubate for 1.5 hours at 37°C.
Heat inactivate the samples at 80°C for 5 minutes.
Mix 1.5 μL proteinase K (600 mAU/mL) to all samples.
Incubate the mixture at 37°C for 20 min.
Perform an agarose gel electrophoresis at 130 V for 40 min.
Analyze the activity of SaCas9 by observing two DNA fragments with sizes of 281 bp and 228 bp.
